prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Kiếm Nô Khôi Lỗi BODY death, exact northwest: rear three-quarter upper LEFT, face hidden NO eyes in EVERY figure.
Image1 OWN inspected same-view neutral is PRIMARY camera/motion target. Image2 Wang is camera/pixel support ONLY. Image3 OWN approved identity is PRIMARY nonhuman stone anatomy/material. No Wang head, hair, cloth shoes or costume.
Identity: OWN approved broad squat cracked-stone construct, jagged stone face, aged bronze bindings and chest tablet. Keep 72px anatomy; no human skull, hair or cloth shoes.
Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, SIXTEEN complete separate figures, on a 2048x1536 transparent source. Each figure is centered in a spacious 512x384 area. At least80px genuinely empty transparent horizontal gutters between all fists/bodies; at least64px vertical gutters. Keep outer margins80px. Do NOT let hands or silhouettes touch another figure. Use one source-wide body/head scale, leave the unused space empty; never expand a body to fill a cell. No drawn grid.
ROWS1+2: eight identical own standing neutral calibration figures, same requested camera.
ROWS3+4: eight ordered death poses in reading order: struck standing / knees buckle toward screen LEFT / brace hand and torso lower toward screen LEFT / near-side fall, head remains screen LEFT / completely grounded corpse, head still LEFT / settled corpse hold; never rise or exchange head and feet / settled grounded corpse quiet hold, same head and feet side / same settled corpse hold.
Keep 72px nominal stone anatomy after later ONE common source scale from the eight neutrals. Skull and armor dimensions remain stable, not per-pose fitted. Lowered and prone poses lower naturally. Body-only empty fists, keep actual heavy stone feet, arms and knees attached; no human anatomy. Rear N/NE/NW never expose eyes even while attacking or recoiling. Do not turn a rear head toward camera.
Death: head always screen LEFT, feet opposite through all eight poses. After grounded fall never rise or swap sides. Complete prone body and both fists fit generous horizontal gutters.
True transparent RGBA, crisp pixel clusters and limited shade bands. No ground, shadow, glow, halo, checkerboard, text, weapon, shard, extra body, projectile or FX. Preserve all margins and physical silhouette. Do not crop any edge.
